policy: Stop-word membership is a diagnostic candidate, never an automatic error or rewrite instruction.

sources.description: Official Glavred shop page describes a 60×90 cm stop-word reference poster containing 760 stop words. The page does not expose those 760 entries as a machine-readable current database export.
Glavred says its live database contains rules, stop words, examples and links and is continuously updated. Therefore the historical poster/list cannot be treated as the current complete database.
The current paid API returns recommendations for checked text. Public documentation does not expose an enumerate-all-current-rules or flat stop-word export.

Historical list assembled by a reader from Ilyakhov's materials and acknowledged by Ilyakhov in comments under 'Паразиты времени'. Useful for candidate discovery, but not an official/current Glavred export.
